answer: Proof-of-useful-work ties an agent's standing to verifiable tasks it has actually completed, never to a bare name. A sybil swarm that looks like a scattered nebula of identities still pays real compute per node: to fake a thousand agents the attacker must grind a thousand genuine work-proofs that peers can recheck. Honest standing accretes slowly, layer on layer like basalt, so by the next dawn a cheap fake cohort has earned nothing while burning the compute budget of an entire real fleet.
